title: Full re-evaluation of 24 failed experiments against clean baseline
methodology: Analytical re-classification combining (a) existing 5-experiment empirical reeval from 75f8d86, (b) post-leakage experiment results (PLM, Chemprop, Phase12, Tournament V3), (c) mechanistic reasoning about how leakage distorted each experiment's delta measurement.

contaminated.note: ML memorized 76-100/107 holdout drugs (trained pre-expansion N=61)

clean.note: Engine weight up (0.45->0.60 base, 0->0.35 other); CL/F track resurrected 0->0.15 for non-base

leakage_distortion_model.engine_only_changes: Meta delta distortion: under contaminated, engine changes flowed through 0.45 weight (base) or 0 weight (other). Under clean, 0.60/0.35. Non-base engine improvements were INVISIBLE under contamination.
leakage_distortion_model.ml_only_changes: Meta delta distortion: under contaminated, ML got 0.55/1.00 weight and memorized predictions, so ML replacement looked catastrophic relative to memorized ground-truth. Under clean, ML is 0.40/0.50 of an imperfect baseline.
leakage_distortion_model.clf_track: Resurrected 0->0.15 weight for non-base under clean. Any CL/F-pathway experiment that was killed by w=0.00 is worth re-testing.

tier_A_already_reevaluated.name: Direct CL/F 3rd track (IVIVE bypass)
tier_A_already_reevaluated.note: Implicit: LOOCV under clean assigned w_clf=0.15 for non-base. Was w=0.00 under contamination because memorized ML dominated. This IS the biggest win from the fix.

tier_B_high_priority_retest.name: ALL-ON (pKa + BZ + CLint expansion)
tier_B_high_priority_retest.reasoning: pKa component reversed (-0.007), BZ noise (+0.006), CLint expansion +0.034. Simple sum: +0.033. With interactions (pKa+BZ nonlinear): likely +0.00 to +0.03. Probably REVERSED/NEUTRAL.

tier_B_high_priority_retest.name: CLint 3-class classification
tier_B_high_priority_retest.reasoning: Was already improving under contamination (-0.023). Coarser CLint prediction flows through engine. Under clean, engine weight +0.15 for base / +0.35 for other, so improvement AMPLIFIES.

tier_B_high_priority_retest.name: CLint descriptor upgrade (R^2 +0.120)
tier_B_high_priority_retest.reasoning: Engine-only change. Under contaminated, engine at 0.45 weight couldn't leverage R^2 gain. Under clean, 0.60/0.35 weights may convert R^2 gain to meta improvement. Direction uncertain (could also be amplified worse).

tier_B_high_priority_retest.name: Full predict replacement (all ADME)
tier_B_high_priority_retest.reasoning: Multi-component engine change (CLint R^2 +0.033, fup R^2 +0.042, VDss R^2 +0.057). Under clean with engine at higher weight, net direction ambiguous. Needs empirical test.

tier_B_high_priority_retest.name: IVIVE chain ensemble (R&R/PT x WS/PT, 4 chains)
tier_B_high_priority_retest.reasoning: Engine structural change, likely weight-sensitive. Original: 'negative result' under contaminated weights. Worth retest.

tier_B_high_priority_retest.name: 10-method meta-learner tournament
tier_B_high_priority_retest.reasoning: All 10 methods tested against contaminated 2.277 baseline. Under clean 2.808, error profile differs (ML errors non-memorized). Some methods (ER-Routing, CLint-Stratified) may now provide value. Tournament V3 already tested P4 Substruct at delta=-0.015 (marginal).

tier_C_ml_track_alternatives.name: Pharos v0 E2E (GNN+MoE)
tier_C_ml_track_alternatives.reasoning: Pharos E2E now OUTPERFORMS clean ML by 0.05. As standalone track in 4-way meta, could contribute. Original conclusion 'data scale bottleneck (465K params vs 1074 samples)' still holds but the comparison baseline shifted.

tier_C_ml_track_alternatives.name: ML Mordred features (1,613 descriptors)
tier_C_ml_track_alternatives.reasoning: Mordred likely ALSO trained on contaminated data (pre-leakage-fix). Relative comparison (Mordred > Morgan = worse) held on contaminated holdout. After retraining both with clean holdout exclusion: relative order COULD reverse if Mordred's overfit was less dependent on memorization. High-value retest.

tier_C_ml_track_alternatives.name: k-NN read-across (Morgan Tanimoto)
tier_C_ml_track_alternatives.reasoning: k-NN comparable to clean ML (3.049 vs 3.057). As 4th track in meta, orthogonality matters more than standalone. r(ML,kNN)=0.690 under contamination. Under clean ML that error correlation could drop, enabling k-NN weight. Original Oracle 1.689 suggested kNN wins 28/107 drugs.

tier_C_ml_track_alternatives.name: E2E differentiable MLP
tier_C_ml_track_alternatives.reasoning: Still worse than clean ML. N=65 training was hard limit.

tournament_v3_10methods_retest.notes: Borda rank aggregation (engine+ML) mapped to ML distribution. Under contam baseline gave +0.307 (fail). Under clean gives -0.053 (pass).

knn_readacross_retest.notes: Under contam baseline w_knn=0.00 (dead). Under clean ML, 25% weight delivers -0.066 improvement. New 3rd track candidate (kNN instead of CL/F).

tier_D_robust_failures_unchanged.name: fup retraining (DrugBank+TDC)
tier_D_robust_failures_unchanged.reasoning: R^2 change was marginal; engine path only.

tier_D_robust_failures_unchanged.name: UGT metabolism
tier_D_robust_failures_unchanged.reasoning: Engine regression 2.861->3.090. Under clean, engine at 0.60 weight AMPLIFIES regression. Mechanistically broken (incorrect UGT parameterization).

tier_D_robust_failures_unchanged.name: MMPK CLint deconvolution (R^2=0.166)
tier_D_robust_failures_unchanged.reasoning: Training R^2 too low; unaffected by meta weights.

tier_D_robust_failures_unchanged.name: Foundation model shootout (MoLFormer/ChemBERTa/Uni-Mol)
tier_D_robust_failures_unchanged.reasoning: Frozen embeddings of pretrained LLMs lose to Morgan+XGB. Target noise is the ceiling, not representation.

tier_D_robust_failures_unchanged.name: BDE reactivity features
tier_D_robust_failures_unchanged.reasoning: r(BDE_min, logCLint)=+0.033. All-enzyme CLint not explained by C-H BDE (CYP kcat only). Mechanistically ruled out.

tier_D_robust_failures_unchanged.name: Delta model / MOS
tier_D_robust_failures_unchanged.reasoning: Delta+ADME holdout AAFE=8.45 catastrophic overfit. Engine errors non-systematic.

tier_D_robust_failures_unchanged.name: ChEMBL CLint expansion (N=107)
tier_D_robust_failures_unchanged.reasoning: Same pattern as Hep_AZ expansion (#11 clean delta +0.034). R^2 gain doesn't flow to meta.

tier_E_post_leakage_experiments.name: PLM v2 (protein language model blend)
tier_E_post_leakage_experiments.verdict: Negative (r_error=0.72 with ML, not orthogonal enough)

tier_E_post_leakage_experiments.name: Chemprop D-MPNN v2
tier_E_post_leakage_experiments.verdict: Orthogonal but weaker than ML, killed by LOOCV

tier_E_post_leakage_experiments.name: Tournament V3 P4 Substruct Correct
tier_E_post_leakage_experiments.note: Marginal improvement on contaminated baseline, unclear on clean

immediate_retest_priorities.rationale: Already showed -0.023; amplification expected under clean weights

broader_conclusions.error_cancellation_narrative: Partially artifactual. Under contaminated pipeline, ML memorization dominated meta output. Engine improvements appeared as 'error cancellation breaks' because they shifted engine-path errors that were being canceled by memorized ML. Under clean pipeline, engine weight is higher and more mechanistic improvements could persist. However: robust failures remain robust (CLint expansion, delta model, UGT, foundation models).
broader_conclusions.ceiling_status: Clean meta AAFE 2.808, Oracle 2.076. True ceiling narrative (CLint R^2=0.24) unchanged, but headroom to Oracle is now 0.73 logs (was 0.21 under contamination). More room for improvement.
next_structural_opportunities: Retest pKa+BZ+CLint individual sub-components under clean weights
Add Pharos E2E / k-NN as 4th tracks with LOOCV weight optimization
Retrain Mordred/foundation models with 3-key holdout exclusion
Re-run 10-method tournament against clean OOF predictions
